backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the office rental backend, defining Property/Area data types, CRUD operations, search/filter queries, and user profile management with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the replacement of the saturated yellow theme with a clean white OKLCH-based theme, referencing the affected CSS file and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose, styling approach, and key functionality.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property color tokens for light and dark modes with a white/near-black neutral palette.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'officerentdubai.com' and mounting the app at the root div.
frontend/public/google-site-verification: Empty Google site verification file placeholder.
frontend/public/googlea70a8e0aae5c8967.h: Google site verification file containing the verification token string for domain ownership confirmation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (public listings, listing details, agent arena, dashboard, property management) wrapped in ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/agent/MultiPhoto: Agent-facing component for uploading multiple property images with progress tracking, preview grid, and individual image removal using ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/agent/PropertyFo: Reusable form component for creating and editing property listings, with fields for title, location, type, furnishing status, area, price, description, washrooms, permit number, and photo upload.
frontend/src/components/auth/AgentProtec: A route guard component that redirects unauthorized users to the agent entry page and shows an access-denied card if the agent code auth check fails.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Renders a site footer with copyright year and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution link using the current hostname as a UTM parameter.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Sticky top navigation header with the OfficeRentDubai logo linking to home and a nav link to the Agent Arena page.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Wrapper layout component that composes SiteHeader, a flex-growing main content area, and SiteFooter.
frontend/src/components/listings/Contact: Renders a WhatsApp contact button that pre-fills a message with the property title and listing URL for a hardcoded agent phone number.
frontend/src/components/listings/Propert: Displays a property listing card with image, title, location, permit number, area, washrooms, and price, linking to the individual listing page.
Shows a main property image with a thumbnail carousel below it, allowing users to select which image to display as the main view.
frontend/src/components/search/PropertyS: A search bar component with location autocomplete (with keyboard navigation), property type, furnishing status, area, and price filters that calls an onSearch callback with the assembled filter object.
frontend/src/config/publicEnv.ts: Exports a publicEnv object that reads the VITE_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY build-time environment variable for use across the frontend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: Generic hook that returns a debounced version of a given value, updating only after the specified delay has elapsed since the last change.
frontend/src/hooks/useGooglePlacesAutoco: Hook that lazily loads the Google Places API and returns debounced autocomplete suggestions restricted to UAE with a Dubai location bias.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via an `InternetIdentityProvider` wrapper component.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocationAutocomple: Hook that wraps `useBackendAutocompleteSuggestions` to return location autocomplete suggestions, loading state, and normalized error messages from backend-stored properties.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for backend interactions including user profile, user role, property search/CRUD, and location autocomplete suggestions via a debounced actor-based query.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS with custom CSS variables for a light/dark theme and defines base component styles for hero sections, property cards, and search containers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentArenaEntry: Agent login page that validates an agent code via `agentCodeAuth` and redirects to the agent dashboard on success, or shows an error on failure.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentDashboardP: Agent dashboard page showing property stats (total, office, retail counts) with navigation cards to add or manage properties, wrapped in AgentProtectedRoute with logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/agent/ManagePropertie: Page for agents to view, edit, and delete all listed properties in a grid layout, with error handling for authorization and backend errors via toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/agent/PropertyEditorP: Combined create/edit property page that uses URL params to determine mode, submits form data via create or update mutations, and handles backend/auth errors with toast messages.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailsPage.ts: Page component that fetches and displays full details for a single property listing by ID, including an image gallery, property attributes, and a contact agent button.
frontend/src/pages/PublicListingsPage.ts: Public-facing page with a hero section and search bar that filters and displays a grid of available commercial property listings based on user-selected criteria.
frontend/src/utils/agentCodeAuth.ts: Utility managing agent authentication state in localStorage using a hardcoded agent code, with methods to authorize, check status, logout, and retrieve the code for backend calls.
frontend/src/utils/backendError.ts: Utility that normalizes raw canister/backend errors by stripping common error prefixes and detecting authorization-related keywords, returning a structured NormalizedError object.
frontend/src/utils/googlePlacesLoader.ts: Singleton loader for the Google Maps JavaScript API with the Places library, ensuring the script is loaded only once and exposing helpers to check load status and errors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, defining dark mode, content paths, custom theme tokens (colors via OKLCH CSS variables, fonts, border radius, shadows, animations), and plugins including typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 3) for the 'Office Rent Dubai' app, recording an existing feature that replaced a yellow theme with a white theme and a pending new feature request to apply a white color theme.
